Maxixe District Stage

Round 1 [May 18]
Arsenal Chicucue 	 1-3 Centro Juvenil de Maxixe 
Liga Muçulmana de Maxixe 2-0 Lusitanos Dinzuano de Homoine
In the game Liga Muçulmana - Lusitanos, the second team played the first 32 min. with 10 men. Then the president of the club entered in the match as eleventh player. In the interval apearred two more players (probably from the public), who entered as substitutes. Altough in the 47th minute a Homoine player was sent off. So Lusitanos played 77 min. with 10 men. After the game Homoine`s president complained that the draw was carried in the last moment and there was no time to find players.  Source: RM and Todor Krastev (todor1966@yahoo.com).

National Super Cup
==================
